title: Verify Git mode and blob identity together
summary: Extend archive verification to compare the expected tracked path, Git mode and blob while preserving existing version graphs.
acceptance_criteria: On standard public Linux, a mode-only change fails the archive check.
A clean archive reproduces the existing graph and receipt bytes.
Check Git modes from the index or tree and report the mismatched path.

evidence.claim: The candidate accepts both regular Git modes but stores just the blob ID for archive comparison.
